event_name: Date 08 September 2019 Time 13:27 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 47), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The gearbox of car 7 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired. This penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start from the pit lane for a prior infringement.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 7 Gearbox
